risk_if_not_implemented: Without Alternate Sources for Continued Support, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may be unknown, untracked, lost, stolen or left unprotected because they are not inventoried. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Exposure from Unaddressed Vulnerabilities (R-EX-6), Concentration / Single-Point Dependency Failure (R-OR-2), Third-Party Dependency Failure (R-SC-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Supplier Financial Distress / Insolvency (MT-24), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Configuration Management Program
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of configuration management controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Configuration Management Program (CFG-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Alternate Sources for Continued Support (AST-39.1) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Vulnerability Remediation Process
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure that vulnerabilities are properly identified, tracked and remediated.
compensating_control_2.justification: Vulnerability Remediation Process (VPM-06) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Alternate Sources for Continued Support (AST-39.1) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
